parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: DtsJobName
parameters.description:
The new name of the task.
> Configure a descriptive name that has business meaning (uniqueness is not required) for easy identification.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the task. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
- **true**: The node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node.
- **false**: The node is not a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node.
